description: Analytical solution for 2-variable bounded integer LP with minimum-excess constraint

method.name: Analytical enumeration for bounded 2-variable ILP
steps: Identify feasible region: X >= 2Y + 300 (binding constraint), X + Y <= 1000
Since c_X=4 > c_Y=3 and we minimize cost, prefer Y=0 (lower coefficient)
Set Y=0 => X >= 300 from coupling, X <= 1000 from budget
Minimum cost at Y=0, X=300: objective = 4*300 + 3*0 = 1200

description: MILP formulation using PuLP with integer variables

method.name: MILP with PuLP: integer variables X,Y; constraints X+Y<=1000, X>=2Y+300; minimize 4X+3Y
steps: Define integer variables X >= 0, Y >= 0 using LpVariable('X',0,None,LpInteger)
